open_points.subject: model_items
open_points.text: model_items: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer, for a value that is a model of the models module, one pair for each field the model declares, holding the field's name and the value the field holds, in the order the model declares its fields, and MUST answer None for any other value, a tuple, an enumeration member and None included.
open_points.question: Either runtime model types must be imported so model_items can identify models owned by the models module, or the requirement must define supported models using the available BaseModel type.

open_points.text: model_items: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer, for a value that is a model of the models module, one pair for each field the model declares, holding the field's name and the value the field holds, in the order the model declares its fields, and MUST answer None for any other value, a tuple, an enumeration member and None included.
open_points.other_text: Read from a model value only the fields listed for its type; never use getattr(value, name, default) to probe for a field that is not declared.
open_points.question: Either the runtime model surface must list every readable field, or model_items must be explicitly permitted to enumerate and read declared Pydantic fields generically.

open_points.text: model_items: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer, for a value that is a model of the models module, one pair for each field the model declares, holding the field's name and the value the field holds, in the order the model declares its fields, and MUST answer None for any other value, a tuple, an enumeration member and None included.
open_points.other_text:
Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; every declared field and operation is
  addressed directly by name, including in try/finally cleanup.
open_points.question: Either model_items must receive a finite imported model surface whose fields can be addressed directly by name, or the gate must permit a non-probing Pydantic field-enumeration operation for this generic function.
